Cluster and draw dendrograms

Source: R/dendro.R
calor_dendro.Rd

Reorders rows and/or columns by hierarchical clustering and draws the trees beside the heatmap, aligned leaf to cell. Precomputed hclust or dendrogram objects are accepted.

Usage

calor_dendro(
  rows = TRUE,
  cols = FALSE,
  method = "complete",
  dist = "euclidean",
  k = NULL,
  highlight = FALSE,
  size = 12,
  colour = "#2B2B2B",
  linewidth = 0.4,
  show_tree = TRUE
)

Arguments

rows, cols

TRUE to cluster that axis, FALSE to leave it, or an hclust / dendrogram object to use as is.

method

Linkage method passed to stats::hclust().

dist

Distance measure passed to stats::dist(), or a function taking the matrix and returning a dist.

k

Cut the tree into k clusters and colour the branches.

highlight

Shade the k clusters behind the tree, as in many publication figures.

size

Height of a column tree or width of a row tree, in millimetres.

colour

Line colour when k is NULL.

linewidth

Line width of the branches.

show_tree

Set to FALSE to reorder without drawing. Equivalent to calor_order("cluster") but with your own linkage and distance.

Value

An object to add to a ggcalor() plot with +.

Examples

m <- matrix(rnorm(200), 20, 10, dimnames = list(paste0("g", 1:20), paste0("s", 1:10)))
ggcalor(m) + calor_dendro(rows = TRUE, cols = TRUE)

ggcalor(m) + calor_dendro(rows = TRUE, k = 3, highlight = TRUE)
